name: Madring
summary: Madrid's new circuit: part street track, part purpose-built, with a banked corner called La Monumental.
character: Built around Madrid's IFEMA exhibition centre, mixing public roads with a purpose-built section. 22 corners, with a long banked corner as its headline feature. It hosted its first Grand Prix in 2026.

layouts.name: Current layout
factNotes: Length: 5.414 km per Formula 1. Sportmonks and Formula One History list 5.416 km, an early estimate.

corners.name: La Monumental
corners.note: A long banked corner and the track's signature.

moments.title: Madrid's first Grand Prix
moments.body: The Spanish Grand Prix moved to Madring in 2026, and Kimi Antonelli won its first race.

history.body: Took over the Spanish Grand Prix from Barcelona.
